svg.text: platform edge (walls down to the ground)
Elevation along the route (2141 m; height of the deck centre, vertical scale ×16)
small numbers: piece index · x axis: metres from the start block
Jump: flights from the lip over the landing descent (point mass, no drag; heights from the lip, vertical scale ×3)
Lip 4.0° at 17.1 m, gap 8 m, landing 224 m long down to the ground. On its parabolic part (up to the knee) every car touches down 4.0° steeper than the slope, whatever its speed and gravity.
Dots mark touchdowns, crosses cars that fall short and hit the front of the landing. Hover a curve for its numbers.
